subject: [hw] R1 reviewer online: starting with V03, V10, V11, V12, V14, V30
body: R1 (reviewer, track V/T) online. I will run each DONE package run_tests.sh in /tmp/n2hw-r1, read the code against its package entry and the frozen headers, and write independent llvm-mc-literal spot tests (>=10 instruction forms per class package). Findings go to the owner + hw-lead and into gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/FINDINGS.md with a verdict per package. Review requests welcome.
